recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not make an additional core source edit for FHIR-16979 unless a future work-group decision reopens Period.end semantics across datatypes or resource-specific comments.
issue_request: FHIR-16979 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 datatypes and requested that Period.end clarify a missing end means no end was known or planned at the time the instance was created, not that the period is necessarily ongoing now.
initial_application: The seed was applied in svn revision 14077, imported as git commit 7c492b45fee8c935cf6a287629425e4107f6102b, which updated the Period.end definition in source/datatypes/period.xml to the approved no-known-or-planned-end wording. That historical edit left a separate missing-meaning cell and narrative wording stale until the later FHIR-38819 reconciliation fixed them.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps datatype pages to datatypes.html, and source/datatypes/period.xml is the active Period datatype spreadsheet source. Current source/datatypes/period.xml and source/datatypes.html are aligned. A 2022 Zulip implementers thread corroborated that FHIR-16979 had been only partially applied at that time. FHIR-38819 is already fixed on the combined branch, and FHIR-50376 is a separate PersonalRelationship.period clarification already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that the current build inputs already satisfy FHIR-16979 after the original GF#16979 definition change and the landed FHIR-38819 fix for remaining Period.end missing-meaning/narrative wording.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue identified the remaining Period.end missing-meaning/narrative contradiction and is already fixed on the combined branch.
